set.body: Pin eyesim's deterministic fixation-trajectory evaluation and its matched/control finite sampling. eyesim has no random draws from fixations or density surfaces: sample_fixations and rep_fixations (fixations.R) evaluate a fixation trajectory at requested times deterministically. Scope: (1) a native trajectory evaluator in eyes4s matching the corrected eyesim fast/slow paths (hold-last semantics, tie handling, integer replicate counts), shared with eyesim-temporal and fixation overlap; (2) the finite matched/control permutation baseline (exclude every copy of the true match, then sample, realised n_perm) pinned under recorded seeds and RNGkind, with eyes4s's keyed bottom-k selection documented as an intentional divergence in how candidates are drawn. Baseline cases: fixation-trajectory-evaluation, matched-control-finite-sampling.
